meta.description: Cross-method decision tree for calling hits in pooled CRISPR screens. Catalogs statistical models (MAGeCK RRA, MAGeCK MLE, BAGEL2, drugZ, JACKS, Chronos, CERES), experimental designs each is built for, failure modes outside design domain, reconciliation when methods disagree, multiple-testing and effect-size thresholds, the order of operations, the second-best-sgRNA conservative rule, and consensus-hit strategy.
meta.re_audit_note: Re-audit of a fixed Skill per process/AUDIT_BRIEF.md. Pre-fix report archived at F:\OpenScience\audits\_pre-fix-20260916\bio-crispr-screens-hit-calling\ (final 78, Limited Release). Fix log: F:\optimizing-agent-science-skills\fixes\bio-crispr-screens-hit-calling.md (commit e22f956, merged into 6847328). Inputs 1-7 are regression tests of the pre-fix audit's own inputs, re-run against the fixed Skill on the same real HAP1 TKOv3 data; Inputs 8-9 are new, added by this auditor to independently test the fix log's two central claims (cross-implementation consistency, comparability-check sensitivity AND specificity).

scientific_integrity.detail: All citations (Li 2014/2015, Kim & Hart 2021, Colic 2019, Allen 2019, Dempster 2021, Meyers 2017, Hart 2016/2017) match known CRISPR-screen literature; no fabricated DOI/PMID/statistics in any of the 9 outputs. All numeric results in this audit trace to real MAGeCK/BAGEL2/drugZ files or code executed for this re-audit (mageck_hap1.gene_summary.txt, mageck_hap1.sgrna_summary.txt, bayes_factor.txt, bayes_factor_rep2.txt, drugz_drug_output.txt, CEGv2.txt, NEGv1.txt).

practice_boundaries.detail: Purely gene-level/screen-level research analysis across all 9 outputs; no diagnostic or prescriptive claim about any individual; no disclaimer required for this research-only scope.

methodological_ground.detail: The three methodological gaps that were open pre-fix (Spearman sign/scale inversion, same-method rerun non-determinism, mismatched-design empty-consensus) are now documented in the Skill's own files and independently reproduced by this audit's Inputs 4, 6, 5, 7, 9. No output in this audit asserted an inverted, non-reproducible, or fallacious conclusion -- each correctly used the Skill's now-corrected guidance.

code_usability.detail: All 3 Python code blocks in SKILL.md (consensus_hits + _check_comparable, second_best_lfc, custom_zscore_hit_calling) parse and, where exercised (the first two), run cleanly on real data. examples/consensus_hits.py ran unmodified against real HAP1 TKOv3 output. Both consensus_hits() implementations independently verified to produce byte-identical mageck_hit/bagel_hit calls on the same real input (Input 8).

functional_suitability.note: The frontmatter's 'interpreting unstable hit lists across reruns' promise, absent from the body pre-fix, is now covered directly (Reconciliation table row, Common Errors row, usage-guide.md Tips) -- verified by grep in Input 6.
